notes.title: Alpha 8.0 Update
notes.content:
Update Alpha 8.0 is available for download.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39768720/ef92ebec37e78491e0636af7e65d3afee6982c56.png

List of changes: 

 A system of multiple events has been added. Now the simultaneous number of random events on the global map can be from 1 to 4. 
 Improved AI of ground NPCs. 
 When an NPC drops a loot box in the exit area, it is automatically transferred to the player's accessible area. 
 The shadows of the scenery have been improved.
 The ruins of the Forerunners have been renamed the Mausoleum of the Forerunners. 
 A new visited structure has been added – the City of the Forerunners, which can be randomly encountered in the wastelands. 
 Added illumination of the object that the player is currently interacting with. The backlight appears when you press the hint display button (X by default). 
 Added a button to hide the interface on the local map (F2 by default). 
 Added slave trading mechanics. The player can capture wounded enemies, as well as members of his team. Prisoners can be sold at the slave market in the cities of some factions or hired to join their crew.
 New buildings have been added that increase the limit on the number of prisoners in the player's structure: prisoner pit, dungeon, prison. 
 The encounter with the slaver has been changed. Now, in addition to selling slaves, the slaver can also buy your slaves. 
 Added character loyalty feature. It is determined automatically when generating a character and its indicator cannot be found. The level of loyalty depends on whether the character agrees to join your team after being captured, as well as on his likelihood of defecting to the side of the rebels during the riot. 
 A new fraction has been added – Regolith. 
 A new fraction has been added – Megalith. 
 Added cancel sound.
 Duplicated the control of the crawler on the interface.
 The characteristics of the ground monsters have been changed. Monsters now vary in physical size and have different attack power and health levels. The bigger the monster, the stronger the attack and the more health. 
 The amount of dye required to paint the crawler has been changed. Now the quantity depends on the size of the crawler. 
 Location downloads have been optimized. 
 New items added: Forerunner Turret, White Pants, Blue Shirt 1, Brown Shirt 1, Brown Hat 1. 
 Other minor improvements and bug fixes have been made. 


I remind you that saving the old version will not work in Alpha 7.0, but it is possible to install and play an older version.
To do this, right-click on Scraplers in the Steam game library, go to the Properties tab of the BETA version and select the desired version.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39768720/669ce6b1f7569d22b55648100dcf8f062d4ffe4d.png

notes.title: Alpha 7.0 Update
notes.content:
Update Alpha 7.0 is available for download.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39768720/ce2fe3e814e8781866f2fcff28f679dc98d8f1cb.png

List of changes:

 Added tooltips for small icons (player resource icons, settlement faction icons).
 A new resource has been added – water. Added the need for characters to quench their thirst. Water is generated using water generators installed on the crawlers, therefore, each crawler produces a certain amount of water over time.
 A new playable race has been added – Anunags.
 Added the ability to rename characters in the player's team.
 Added mechanics for getting/completing quests. The mechanics of delivering items to settlements have been removed from the game, and item delivery quests have been added instead.
 The Sandstorm event now has a limited time and the amount of flying debris decreases over time.
 The player has added the ability to capture some settlements (block-post, settlement, town) for the faction to which the player belongs. After the destruction of the entire garrison of the location, when entering the global map, the corresponding button will appear.
 Specialization of settlement production has been added. At the start of the game, each location receives one of 20 specializations. Each specialization has a unique list of items that will appear with an increased chance at the settlement merchant.
 Fixed a bug with NPCs pushing against the edge of the map when moving.
 The cost of setting up a construction camp has been removed. Now you can start building a location without having any resources, but unfinished locations are no longer a safe place when moving around the global map and the player can also get into a random encounter, as well as when moving through normal terrain.
 A recipe for crafting a money ticket has been added.
 Added the display of building characteristics in the description window.
 Icons of empty slots for the construction of buildings on the location have been added.
 A new building has been added - Bar. You can build on locations like block-post or town. Once built, the location begins to generate with some chance available for hiring characters.
 A new building has been added - Guest room. It can be built on a Depot type location. Performs the same function as the Bar.
 A new building has been added – a warehouse tent. An inexpensive and affordable version of the building that increases the storage capacity of the location.
 A new building has been added – a residential tent. An inexpensive and affordable version of the building that increases the capacity of the location's garrison.
 A new building has been added - Tent camp. A more expensive option than a residential tent.
 A new building has been added - Tower. A building that adds a slot for the installation of a cannon turret, as well as a small bonus to the storage capacity and garrison of the location.
 A new location has been added, available for player construction – Dot. A small fortified camp that can be well defended.
 The cost of all buildings in the game has been rebalanced.
 Added yellow highlighting of the names of all unique characters in the game.
 A new playable faction has been added – Goblenots.
 A new playable faction has been added – Troodonits.
 A new vehicle has been added - the Artillery Gobr.
 A new order of food and water consumption by the player's crew has been established. The characters with the least amount of health are the first to receive food.
 A new type of visited locations has been added – the Tech station. The tech station is a place where the player can repair the crawler.
 A new ground mob has been added – Magma Gnus.
 Added a recipe and the ability to create an Axe turret.
 Added a new structural mob – Toolhit-jelly.
 Two new types of food have been added: Plastic Paste and Processed Arachnid Meat.
 New items added: Cannon, Shovel 1, Knife 3, Knife 4, Helmet 7, Helmet 8, Ancient idol, Bed, Electric Element, Spear 2, Harness 3, Jacket 6.
 A new music track has been added.
 Other minor improvements and bug fixes have been made.



I remind you that saving the old version will not work in Alpha 7.0, but it is possible to install and play an older version.
To do this, right-click on Scraplers in the Steam game library, go to the Properties tab of the BETA version and select the desired version.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39768720/669ce6b1f7569d22b55648100dcf8f062d4ffe4d.png

notes.title: Alpha 6.0 update
notes.content:
Update  Alpha 6.0  is available for download. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39768720/05b497f89e2600a9dc38f7e0fb3dca02208432df.png

 List of changes: 


 Redesigned character card.
 Added a character morality system. The morale indicator is displayed in the character card in a blue square. Various factors such as hunger or injury affect the character's morale.
 New item: Bullet. A new type of ammunition used by characters when shooting firearms.
 Added bandolier for characters. Each game character has a bandolier with a capacity of 12 pieces, for storing bullets. The bandolier is automatically replenished when the player enters the local map or after boarding, if there are bullets in the player's inventory. The bandolier can also be replenished or emptied by clicking on its icon.
 During boarding, an attacking character with a firearm spends a bullet from the bandolier.
 All crawlers and cannon turrets have added embrasures for shooting firearms at enemies. Each shot spends a bullet from the crawler/tower inventory.
 Added display of crew roles. At the moment there are 3 crew roles: captain, cannoneer and shooter. Roles are automatically distributed among the crew depending on the importance of the role – first of all, the captain is appointed, then the cannoneer and only then the shooters.
The captain is responsible for the ability to control the crawler. The captain is any character who occupies the first place in the crew list.
Any character becomes a cannoneer, if there are turrets on the crawler / tower. Each turret requires two cannoneers to be able to fire.
Shooters are any characters who have firearms in their hands with a sufficient number of embrasures at the crawler. One shooter occupies one embrasure, starting from the left side of the crawler.
 Added the display of money amount and bullets in the player's inventory.
 Added a new random structure on locations – "Large carcass". It is a large destroyed crawler with enemies and containing random loot.
 Added backup saving of the game, which occurs every ½ of the game day. The save is placed in the folder "\AppData\Roaming\Scraplers\Saves\Reserve saves" and, if necessary, can be moved to the Saves folder for later download.
 Added the sound of receiving message in the dialog box.
 Some factions have a requirement for the presence of an item in the player's inventory to join the faction.
 The "Pirates" faction is divided into two friendly with each other pirate factions: "Rusty" and "Rippers".
 "Presbyters of War" are separated into a faction.
 "Sewer goblitrops" are separated into a fraction.
 "Cyberdemons" are separated into a faction.
 Added a new faction – "Redocolor".
 The process of saving the game is now displayed in the upper right corner of the screen in the form of a small floppy disk icon.
 The construction camp at the player's location is no longer a static decoration, but is randomly generated.
 Added a new playable race – Rasklor.
 Added a new location for the player to build – Stash.
 Added a new location for the player to build – Depot. New premises for construction at the depot have been added: depot barracks, depot warehouse, depot workshop.
 Added a menu for selecting location to build.
 Changed the mechanism of robbing player locations. Loot looting does not occur until the combat capability of the location drops to zero, that is, while there are defensive turrets or a garrison on the base. The greater the combat capability of the location, the less chance the attackers have to damage the location. Also, each type of location has its own visibility parameter for the enemy, so, for example, the "Block-post" location will be attacked more often than the "Stash" location.
 Added a new special mercenary - the T-02 Iron Tank.
 Added a new rare armor set: Iron Tank Helmet, Iron Tank Hydraulic Armor, Iron Tank Hydraulic Legs.
 Slightly redesigned the appearance of hydraulic suits in the game.
 Added skin colors for all races in the game. Also added a choice of skin color to player character during the initial setup.
 Locations belonging to the player are now displayed in blue on the global map.
 Added new items: Red Hat 1, Red Coat 2, Armored Red Coat 2, Red Hydraulic Armor 2, Helm 6.
 Made other minor improvements and bug fixes.



Let me remind you that saving the old version will not work in Alpha 5.0, but it is possible to install and play the older version.
To do this, right-click in the game library on Steam on Scraplers, go to Properties - BETA VERSIONS tab and select the desired version.

notes.title: Crafting, difficulty levels, AI improvements in Alpha 2.0.
notes.content:
News about new changes in version Alpha 2.0.
1) Crafting system.
Crafting items, opens after the player builds a factory at his base. By analogy with the building construction system, crafting items will also require the necessary resources in warehouse and a studied blueprint, but in addition, some items will require the presence of built buildings at the base.
Crafting recipes, like most other items, will be randomly found in the Wasteland as loot or sold by merchants. The received recipes, when they are studied, will immediately open several items for crafting, similar in production. For example, when studying the "Textile Industry" blueprint, the player will discover recipes for crafting textile clothing (pants, hoods, bandanas, cloth shoes), as well as the production of the main resource for this clothing - fabric.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39768720/69be408d358bc1b30e7e9db7a972b17db6247290.png
2) Improved intelligence of NPCs and imitation of life near cities.
Improved AI behavior of NPCs, enemies without guns now do not go in an undefined direction, but try to ram the player and take him on board. Also added a simulation of wandering around the map of some peaceful NPCs and a simulation of visiting cities. When the player enters the territory of the settlement, from time to time, neutral crawlers will drive up and leave the city.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39768720/e02ce0345f829b53ec51256e95868908301f4619.png
3) Difficulty levels.
3 difficulty levels have been added to the game to make life easier for new players.
Hard - everything remains the same as in the Alpha 1.X version: the player takes full damage and loses almost everything on death.
Normal - the player takes full damage, but on death he loses only a part of the load and the team. The crawler and its weapons remain with the player, the crawler's HP level drops to 1.
Easy - all damage received by the player is reduced by 2 times, and upon death he loses only a part of the load and the team. The crawler and its weapons remain with the player, the crawler's HP level drops to 1.
4) Tooltips on buttons and a global minimap.
For some interface buttons, tooltips have been added that appear when the cursor is hovering over the button, and a mini-map has been added on the global map, with the designation of all cities and player's points.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39768720/f58af60b4a8413e08cc1d3a8c500783431b14a74.png

All these changes will become available with the release of Alpha 2.0.
